claims.claim: Infleqtion's post-combination capital structure creates a concrete per-share dilution/overhang channel independent of operating execution: immediately after the February 2026 business combination the company had 216,471,927 common shares and 10,424,967 warrants outstanding, while the PIPE itself issued 12,654,760 shares at $10.00 per share.

This is a financing-structure risk rather than evidence of present business deterioration: the same transaction delivered approximately $528.2 million of gross proceeds, so the relevant falsifier is whether future operating progress and cash durability reduce reliance on additional equity faster than warrant/equity issuance expands the share base.

risks.risk: Outstanding warrants and the enlarged post-combination share base create potential per-share dilution/overhang if operating cash generation does not improve before additional financing is needed.

contradictions.contradiction: The business combination simultaneously strengthened liquidity and expanded the equity/warrant base; liquidity resilience and dilution exposure therefore coexist rather than cancel each other.
contradictions.disposition: quantifiable financing tradeoff for Alpha to incorporate; not a standalone blocker

unknowns.unknown: The future exercised/expired warrant mix and the amount of any additional equity financing required before durable self-funding remain unknown.
